description: This file defines an internal class `LocalSiloHealthMonitor` that implements health monitoring heuristics for a local node in an Orleans cluster. It includes methods for assessing various health metrics such as node suspicion, probe responses, thread pool delays, and local health checks, and providing an overall health degradation score.

classes.name: LocalSiloHealthMonitor
classes.description: Monitors the health of the local Orleans silo using heuristics such as suspicion votes, response times, thread pool delays, and health check participants, producing a degradation score and complaints list.

classes.name: ThreadPoolMonitor
classes.description: Nested class that measures the delay in the .NET ThreadPool queue to detect potential starvation or GC pauses.

methods.name: GetLocalHealthDegradationScore
methods.description: Calculates a composite health degradation score based on suspicion votes, probe responses, thread pool delays, and local health checks.

methods.name: CheckThreadPoolQueueDelay
methods.description: Checks if the .NET ThreadPool queue has delays indicating potential issues.

methods.name: CheckSuspectingNodes
methods.description: Checks if this node is suspected by others or is not active.

methods.name: CheckReceivedProbeRequests
methods.description: Checks for recent received ping requests from other nodes.

methods.name: CheckReceivedProbeResponses
methods.description: Checks for recent successful ping responses from other nodes.

methods.name: CheckLocalHealthCheckParticipants
methods.description: Runs various local health checks through registered participants.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Background task that periodically assesses health and updates complaints.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers this monitor in the silo's lifecycle.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the periodic health monitoring task.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops the monitoring task and cleans up resources.
